items.prompt: Shade one quarter of the bar.
hints: A quarter is one of four equal parts.
The bar is cut into 4 parts.
items.explanation: One quarter means 1 out of 4 equal parts. Shade 1 part of the bar.

items.prompt: True or false: A quarter of 8 is 4.
items.explanation: A quarter of 8 is 2 because 4 groups of 2 make 8. Half of 8 is 4.

items.prompt: True or false: Cutting a pizza into 4 parts of any size gives quarters.
hints: What do quarters have to be?
Are the 4 parts the same size?
items.explanation: Quarters must be 4 equal parts. Parts of different sizes are not quarters.

items.prompt: True or false: Four quarters make one whole.
hints: You get the whole thing again.
items.explanation: If a whole is cut into 4 equal parts, all four parts together make the whole again.

items.prompt: How many quarters make one whole?
hints: A whole is cut into equal parts.
items.explanation: A whole cut into 4 equal parts has 4 quarters.
